title: Abelian expansion of the scalar raw class
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), W and S schemes in universe u, k:W→S a scheme morphism, G an etale module sheaf on W with coefficients Λ, q a natural number, U an object of S.Etale, A and B objects of Over(W), f:A→B a morphism, and z an element of the module raw derived Hom group at B for (Λ,k,G,q,U). Using the concrete prefix of def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-source-prefix, the abelian raw pullback along f of rawModuleAbelianHomMap at B evaluated on z equals rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix followed by derived abelian inverse image of scalarCoefficientFactor at B and abelianCoefficientFactor. This is a formula for the abelian raw pullback alone, with no assertion relating it to the module raw pullback and no source or coefficient coherence equation. Interpret the raw class values occurring in this equation at their native derived Hom types using the concrete identity views [def-sbc-raw-class-native-morphisms]; the elements and equality are unchanged.

proof.text: Apply rawModuleScalar_pullback_abelian_formula to rawModuleAbelianHomMap at B on z.

Rewrite the scalar class with rawModuleScalarHom_evaluate, the canonical-factor evaluation theorem proved by the existing evaluation argument. Unfold rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix, distribute the derived abelian inverse-image functor over composition with Functor.map_comp, and reassociate with Category.assoc. This uses no coherence square and holds for zero classes, empty objects, identity arrows and degree zero. Present raw class inputs and outputs at their native derived Hom types using the concrete identity functions in def-sbc-raw-class-native-morphisms. These return the input element itself; unfolding their identity bodies makes no mathematical change.

theorem rawModuleAbelianHomMap_target_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    rawAbelianClassMorphism (A.hom ≫ k)
      (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) A) q U
      (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
      (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) q _ _
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left B.hom A.hom
        (Over.w f).symm).inv.app ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G))
      U (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U B z)) =
    rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix Λ k G q U A B f z ≫
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          (scalarCoefficientFactor Λ B.hom G (q : ℤ)) ≫
        abelianCoefficientFactor ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G)
          (q : ℤ) A B f)
